introduction: DC WIC provides food and nutrition support for eligible pregnancy, postpartum and early-childhood needs. A clinic appointment completes the application process.
description: DC WIC provides food and nutrition support for eligible pregnancy, postpartum and early-childhood needs. A clinic appointment completes the application process.

sections.who: Applicants must meet WIC’s residency, category, income and nutrition requirements. The local clinic screens potential eligibility before arranging the appointment.
sections.get: Support includes supplemental foods, nutrition guidance, breastfeeding help and health referrals. The clinic explains the food package.
sections.docs:
• Recent DC address evidence.
  • Income records or relevant benefit-enrollment notice.
  • Pregnancy or birth evidence and the child’s immunization record, as requested.
sections.apply:
1. Contact a WIC clinic

    Use the local-site link on DC Health Apply for WIC.

  2. Complete preliminary screening

    Staff ask eligibility questions and arrange a clinic appointment if potentially eligible.

  3. Attend with the requested records

    Confirm which children must attend and allow time for the visit. Ask about communication assistance if needed.
sections.after: Keep follow-up dates and shopping instructions. Call the clinic before missing an appointment.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DC WIC appointment instructions; DC WIC overview. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Does a phone screening enroll me?
No. It leads to an appointment for potentially eligible applicants.
DC’s instructions say eligible children should attend; confirm arrangements with the clinic.
Can a benefits notice support income screening?
The application page lists several benefit notices as evidence.
Use the clinic link on DC Health’s application page.
